name: Metric Capture and Measurement Failure
definition: The chosen metric ceases to track the property it stands for once it becomes the target.
trigger_conditions: Standing or reward is computed from a single scalar
The metric is disclosed to the parties it scores
No periodic revalidation of the metric against outcomes occurs

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: market pricing of governance change as a proxy for governance quality

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F011 Metric Capture and Measurement Failure. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F011
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
